phases.name: Warm-Up
phases.goal: Get the heart rate up gradually before hitting intervals. Do not skip this — cold muscles and HIIT is a recipe for injury.

tip.label: Pace:
tip.text: Start at a comfortable walk (3.0–3.5 mph), bump to a light jog (4.5–5.5 mph) for the last 2 minutes. Incline at 1%.

tip.label: Goal:
tip.text: Resistance level 6–8. Keep RPM above 70. This primes the hips and shoulders before intervals.

phases.name: Block 1 — Bike Intervals
phases.goal: Stationary or assault bike. All-out effort on work intervals — you should not be able to hold a conversation.

tip.label: Effort:
tip.text: RPE 9–10 on the sprint. Max resistance you can sustain for 20 seconds. Spin down completely in the 40s rest — don't keep pedaling.

phases.name: Block 2 — Rower Intervals
phases.goal: Full body explosive effort. Drive with the legs first — 60% legs, 20% core, 20% arms. Keep the chain level.

tip.label: Target:
tip.text: Aim for a split time under 2:10/500m on each interval. If the monitor is confusing, just pull as hard as possible for 30 seconds.

phases.name: Block 3 — Stairmaster Climb
phases.goal: Sustained high-intensity effort targeting glutes and cardiovascular system together. No holding the rails — it defeats the purpose.

tip.label: Protocol:
tip.text: Fast = level 10–12. Moderate = level 6–7. Alternate without stopping. Hands lightly touching rails for balance only — not supporting weight.

phases.name: Block 4 — Treadmill Finisher
phases.goal: Empty the tank. Sprint intervals to finish. This is the hardest block — push through it.

tip.label: Speed:
tip.text: Set treadmill to 8.0–10.0 mph (or the fastest you can safely sustain for 20 seconds). Jump on the rails to reset between intervals, not the belt.

cards.title: Easy Walk — 5 min
cards.desc: Treadmill at 2.5–3.0 mph, flat. Let heart rate come down below 120 bpm before stopping completely.

cards.title: Stretch — 5 min
cards.desc: Hip flexors, quads, hamstrings, calves. Hold each 30–40 seconds. Hydrate — you just did serious work.
